class.name: DSResourceFormatLoader
class.brief_description: Automatic resource loader for DirectStorage texture and package files.
class.description: [DSResourceFormatLoader] is registered automatically by the extension and normally does not need to be instantiated by user code. It recognizes [code].dstex[/code] and [code].dspkg[/code] files, loads [code].dstex[/code] as [Texture2D], loads [code].dspkg[/code] as [Resource], and can resolve bundled texture paths from [code]res://textures.dspkg[/code]. It uses [DSContext], [DSRequest], [GDeflateDecompressor], and [DSTextureCache] internally.
